title: Development of an Autonomous AI Coding Agent using Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and Gemini LLM Frameworks
abstract: arXiv:2608.29096v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The ongoing changes in software engineering requirements have created a substantial need for automated tools which can create secure source code from natural language input. The performance of traditional Large Language Models (LLMs) becomes limited by their "one-shot" capability which results in logical hallucinations together with reduced algorithmic performance during complicated operations. The research presents an autonomous AI Coding Agent which establishes a connection between LLM-generated content and production-ready software through its organized methodology for decision making. Our framework uses the Gemini 2.5 Flash API for essential reasoning capabilities while employing a tailored Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) method to solve code generation challenges as a search operation. translated_title: 基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）与Gemini大语言模型框架的自主AI编程智能体的开发
translated_abstract: 软件工程需求的持续变化，催生了对能够从自然语言输入生成安全源代码的自动化工具的巨大需求。传统大语言模型（LLM）的性能受限于其“一次性生成”能力，这会导致逻辑幻觉，并在复杂任务中降低算法性能。本研究提出了一种自主AI编程智能体，它通过有条理的决策方法论，在大语言模型生成的内容与可用于生产的软件之间建立了桥梁。该框架使用Gemini 2.5 Flash API提供核心推理能力，同时采用定制的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）方法，将代码生成难题转化为搜索操作来解决。该智能体采用“自我批评”评估系统来测试不同的实现方案，并根据准确性和难度水平对其进行排序。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将Gemini大语言模型与定制蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）相结合的自主AI编程智能体，通过“自我批评”评估机制将代码生成转化为搜索问题，从而克服传统LLM一次性生成带来的逻辑幻觉，产出可用于生产环境的软件代码。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an autonomous AI coding agent that combines the Gemini LLM with a tailored Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) method, treating code generation as a search problem guided by a "Self-Critic" evaluation system to overcome the logical hallucinations of one-shot LLM generation and produce production-ready software.
